snippet.title: Looking Up I See Only A Ceiling: The Relapse DLC - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
"Looking Up I See Only A Ceiling: The Relapse" DLC will be released on Steam NEXT WEEK, on 26 September 2024! 🥳
 
After the events of the ceiling...exams are now around the corner: follow the story of a student in the verge of losing control of her mind! ✂️🗓️💥

WISHLIST HERE: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2704190/Looking_Up_I_See_Only_A_Ceiling_The_Relapse/ !
